name: Terrorize
effect: You may use a Social Stat for this move. You may only use this move Once per scene. Put a mark on your foe for the rest of combat. The foe that you land this attack on suffers -X Base Strength, Special, Dexterity, Defense and Special Defense, where X is the amount of times you’ve been KOd this combat.
description: You should be down, you should be beaten, and the fact you aren't...it scares them...Use that.
